Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Cooling, reactant depletion and transport alter the reaction rate; no unconditional water-touch extinguish event.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Cooling/oxygen loss lower modeled reaction rate; no identity-based extinguish.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Use relative flow, geometry and declared drag model; zero relative motion generates no drag.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Zero relative velocity gives zero drag; reversal reverses force and dissipated relative work remains nonnegative.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Account for emitted signal energy, path, attenuation and supported occlusion; an obstructed control receives the predicted diminished field.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Arrival time follows path length/sound speed; declared attenuation and occlusion, wrong tone and duplicate arrival controls.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Trace finite power with geometry-based reflection/refraction and occlusion; focusing redistributes irradiance rather than increasing total energy.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Reflection/refraction follows surface normals and indices; sum transmitted/reflected/absorbed power never exceeds incident.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Allocate only the absorbed fraction to material enthalpy; reflected/transmitted power cannot also become heat.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Absorbed optical energy equals thermal ledger credit; transparent control receives only its absorptance.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Apply supported typed particle/channel/material models and energy deposition; blocked transmission cannot activate a downstream detector.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Independent exponential photon attenuation, charged-particle range and neutron-group transfer with deposited-energy balance.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Advance finite populations with declared emission/energy accounting; spent inventory cannot emit indefinitely.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Population exponential decay and emitted count/energy balance; depleted inventory emits zero.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Read a valid local thermal state with defined response and supplied outputs; observation creates no heat or actuator energy.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Known local temperature crosses distinct on/off thresholds; observation cannot change stored energy.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Transfer equal/opposite energy through geometry/contact conductance along the temperature difference; a missing contact removes that path.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Two thermal masses equilibrate with equal/opposite energy transfer; zero conductance gives zero transfer.

Capabilities.ModelBoundary: Exchange heat between surface and fluid through the declared transfer model; an ambient fan is not an arbitrary cold source.
Capabilities.IndependentOracle: Finite surface/fluid exchange approaches equilibrium without falling below cold reservoir; absent coupling gives zero.
